body.purpose: Dream text, questions, answers, and pact explanations.

motion.name: state-shift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action for continuing the customs flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.510 0.115 234); color: oklch(0.965 0.010 235); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 680 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.590 0.120 232); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.820 0.110 185); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Seal Button
components.description: Final action that seals today's pact.
components.css: .ds-btn-seal { background: oklch(0.705 0.160 28); color: oklch(0.080 0.010 250); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 760 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-seal:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 107, 84, 0.24); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-seal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.965 0.010 235); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: Shows a queued or extracted dream evidence item.
components.css: .ds-evidence-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 30px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.430 0.055 235); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.205 0.035 238); color: oklch(0.965 0.010 235); padding: 5px 10px; font: 650 13px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.820 0.110 185); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(96, 220, 205, 0.35); }

components.name: Bottom Composer
components.description: Codex-style dream declaration input with evidence controls.
components.css: .ds-composer { background: oklch(0.205 0.035 238); color: oklch(0.965 0.010 235); border: 1px solid oklch(0.430 0.055 235); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); } .ds-composer textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 84px; resize: vertical; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 450 16px/1.55 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: oklch(0.760 0.030 232); } .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-composer button { border: 1px solid oklch(0.430 0.055 235); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.275 0.045 236); color: oklch(0.965 0.010 235); padding: 8px 10px; } .ds-composer .ds-send { background: oklch(0.510 0.115 234); border-color: transparent; }

narrative.overview: Dream Customs should feel like a working customs desk that appears inside a dream at 4:17 a.m. The surface is dark because the user often arrives from bed or after waking, but it is not a generic terminal. Cobalt, aurora cyan, and coral stamp ink carry the strange color. Familiar controls carry trust.
keyCharacteristics: Bottom composer as the primary input, modeled after Codex app behavior.
Conversation timeline for declarations, questions, and pact drafts.
Evidence tray for text, image, audio, mood, and model status.
Pact inspector that can be drafted, revised, or sealed.
Generated bitmap art as atmospheric header and state art, never as unreadable UI chrome.

rules.name: The Stamp Rarity Rule
rules.body: Coral is used for sealing, warnings, and permit marks only. It must not become a general decoration color.

rules.name: The No Parchment Rule
rules.body: Do not return to cream, beige, or faux paper backgrounds. Dream color comes from night, ink, and evidence light.

rules.name: The Low-Light Readability Rule
rules.body: Muted text must remain legible on dark surfaces. Never use low-contrast gray for field labels or placeholders.

rules.name: The State First Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate focus, hover, or completion. They are not default decoration.

dos: Do make the bottom composer the most obvious control on mobile and desktop.
Do keep every phase actionable with one clear next step.
Do use generated raster imagery for the dream atmosphere, header state, or empty state.
Do verify dark-mode contrast for body text, labels, placeholders, chips, and disabled controls.
Do preserve a deterministic demo backend while adding a model-backed route.
donts: Don't ship a plain Gradio two-column form as the primary experience.
Don't use beige parchment, tarot, faux therapy, or generic purple AI visuals.
Don't use one-shot generation as the whole flow.
Don't hide Add material, Continue negotiation, or Seal pact below the fold.
Don't pair a 1px border with a large soft shadow on every card.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, or decorative glass panels.
